tenant_select_policies.name: pack_case_events_select_visible_case
tenant_select_policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
 FROM pack_cases c
 WHERE ((c.id = pack_case_events.case_id) AND (c.workspace_id = pack_case_events.workspace_id))))

tenant_select_policies.name: pack_cases_select_reporter_manager
tenant_select_policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
 FROM members m
 WHERE ((m.workspace_id = pack_cases.workspace_id) AND (m.user_id = auth.uid()) AND ((m.user_id = pack_cases.reporter_user_id) OR (m.role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text]))))))
